items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: So there used to be a place called Jimmy Plunkett's.

ctx.x: Now that we've just listened to Bix has stirred this up some more memories?

Yes it has Helen. He was quite a human being this guy. I recall once again in New York City with Ben Pollack's band and between the Little Club and the Park Central Hotel we were off about six or seven weeks. Because Ben Pollack quit the 'Little Club', and no work. So there used to be a place called Jimmy Plunkett's. It was a speak easy on 53rd Street between 7th and Broadway. And that's where all the jazz musicians or the musicians around town, with Jimmy, Tommy Dorsey, Goodman, Bix and all the Whiteman band, oh…

And I recall one day Bix, well no, this is when he, that's right, I'm going a little ahead of my story. I'm inbetween the jobs at the Little Club and the Park Central Hotel which I believe was around 1929.
